name: Claude Code
desc: Coding agent that reads CLAUDE.md and opens pull requests
desc_zh: 命令行编码 Agent：读 CLAUDE.md，最终交付 pull request
solves: Conventions get re-explained at the start of every session. CLAUDE.md holds them, and Claude Code reads that file before it plans.
solves_zh: 项目规范每次都要重新交代一遍。CLAUDE.md 把它们存下来，Claude Code 动手前先读这个文件。
best_for: Multi-day work — a migration, a test suite, a bug hunt — that should end in a pull request.
best_for_zh: 改不动就跑不动的活：迁移、补测试、查一个 bug，最后收在一个 pull request 上。
